description: Assign still UNASSIGNED mails (incoming and sent via send_email) to the records that match their counterpart address. Scope: contact_id (all addresses of that person: main e-mail + additional e-mails), account_id (the organisation's e-mail) or since (ISO date: every unassigned mail since then). Exactly one match → assigned (assignment_state 'auto'); a person, their lead and their organisation count as ONE match. Several different matches → nothing is assigned, the candidates are stored (assignment_state 'ambiguous') for a human to pick with assign_email. Mails whose assignment a human removed are left alone. Runs automatically after create_contact, update_contact (new e-mail) and upsert_contact_point (kind email). Optional: dry_run=true only reports. Max 500 mails per call (more → call again).

dry_run.description: Only simulate and report what would happen; change nothing

name: rematch_emails
